neighbours.label: generic statements about when, where or how often something typically happens ('are most common in', 'usually occur during', 'are another common target'), as against reports of one specific event
fire: Nosebleeds are most common in the winter when the air is dry.
Ear infections are most common in young children.
These errors usually occur during the first week of use.
Flooding tends to happen during the spring thaw.
Olive oil is another common target of food fraud.
Injuries are most common in the first minutes of a match.
Delays usually occur during the holiday rush.
Allergies are most common in people with a family history of asthma.
quiet: My nose bled last night because the air was dry.
Our son had an ear infection last month.
The error appeared during my first week at the new job.
The river flooded during the spring thaw of 1997.
The inspector tested a bottle of olive oil on Tuesday.
He was injured in the first minute of the match.
Our train was delayed during the holiday rush.
My sister developed an allergy to cats last year.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.5 on the preposition or verb after a generic frequency frame; one-off past events below 0.25
